description: This file contains implementation of rational number operations such as bitwise shifts, logical operations, and remainders, specifically for a module named 'ratpak'. It defines functions for left and right shifts, logical AND, OR, XOR, and remainder/modulo operations on rational numbers and their underlying numeric representations.

methods.name: lshrat
methods.description: Performs a left shift operation on a rational number by a specified power, with bounds checking to prevent overflow.

methods.name: rshrat
methods.description: Performs a right shift operation on a rational number by a specified power, with bounds checking to prevent overflow.

methods.name: andrat
methods.description: Performs a bitwise AND operation on two rational numbers.

methods.name: orrat
methods.description: Performs a bitwise OR operation on two rational numbers.

methods.name: xorrat
methods.description: Performs a bitwise XOR operation on two rational numbers.

methods.name: boolrat
methods.description: Performs a logical bitwise operation (AND, OR, XOR) on rational numbers.

methods.name: boolnum
methods.description: Performs a logical bitwise operation (AND, OR, XOR) on numeric representations.

methods.name: remrat
methods.description: Calculates the remainder of division of two rational numbers, similar to the '%' operator.

methods.name: modrat
methods.description: Calculates the modulo of two rational numbers, with sign adjustments to match divisor's sign.
